Now, we have added the Player class.
The constructor is used to get the name of the players. It takes a string parameter type, where type is used for symbols either "X" or "O".
We will assume that the first player will always take the "X" symbol and the second player will always take the "O" symbol.
Inside the Main class, we have created two objects player1 and player2 of the Player class.
Then, we passed "X" and "O" to player1 and player2 respectively while creating their objects.
